semiconductor_relevance: High — Levitronix GmbH specializes in ultrapure pump systems and flow control technologies specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Levitronix GmbH develops and sells advanced ultrapure pump systems and flow control solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products utilize magnetically levitated technology to ensure contact-free operation, minimizing particle generation and contamination during critical processes such as CMP slurry handling and wet cleaning.
capabilities: Ultrapure pump systems for CMP slurry delivery
Flow control systems for high purity fluid transfer
Bearingless fan systems for microelectronics manufacturing
technical_expertise: Particle contamination control in ultrapure applications

regional_presence.Taiwan: Levitronix has a branch in Taiwan, focusing on serving the semiconductor market in the region.
